_comment: Hand-written inputs of the add-on generator: errata, samples, companions and replacements BDS needs. See docs/data-pipeline.md.

errata.why: The docs table names it 'component'; BDS reads 'components' (the docs' own example uses 'components').
Docs list repair_items as String with nested fields at repair_items.items; the description and BDS take a list of {items, repair_amount}.
errata.schema: an element is an array or an object, so the merge makes it a list of arrays
has it, but adds it after repair_amount: the members of the add-on would change order

errata.why: Docs: Keyed set of strings / Named set of objects; BDS takes a number or a molang string.
errata.schema: has it with a default, which leaves it out of the base

errata.why: The single {origin, size} object form of older format versions, probed (rejected by 1.26.60 per the earlier content log).
errata.schema: a probe of older formats, which the schema of format 1.26.60 does not have

errata.why: Docs type column says String; the prose says a Boolean or an array of bone names.
errata.schema: agrees, but the merge puts boolean after the content log's array

errata.why: Docs: Array of items; BDS takes the minecraft:material_instances object.
errata.schema: the merge makes it a map of strings

errata.why: The docs type column says a map of booleans; the prose of item_visual's geometry says the value is a Molang expression (limited to query.block_state()). BDS 1.26.36.1 to 1.26.52.3 refuse a boolean there.
errata.schema: lists a boolean, which those builds refuse

errata.why: Docs: 'A list of block descriptors'; the example uses {tags}.
errata.schema: has it with a default, which leaves it out of the base descriptor

samples._comment: String (or object) values by '<component>:<path>', then by field name. Strings without a sample get paletter_a / paletter_b.
samples.name: minecraft:stone
samples.title: Paletter Container

alternatives._comment: A second valid value for reference fields (and colours), so free-string variants do not name missing content.
alternatives.name: minecraft:dirt

mapValues._comment: Further values of a map's elements, each tried in a map of its own, by '<component>:<path>' then by field name. bone_visibility: how BDS writes a Molang number of each shape, the booleans as text, and expressions. Not among them: an expression BDS computes (it sent '1 + 1' as '2.000000' in the captures of 1.26.36.1 to 1.26.70.24 of 2026-11-17); the encoder does not compute Molang, and the conformance suite waives nothing.

mapKeys._comment: Key used for a map value ({} in a path), by '<component>:<path>' then field name.

probeValues._comment: Further values of a field, each tried as a value of its own, by '<component>:<path>'. Probes, not facts: the names of the hand table of Transforms (FORMATTING) that no BDS message and no schema enum lists (the use_animation names come from the schema enum), and whole lists of objects the minimal entry never writes (an ammunition entry without an item, unverified until captured), and numbers not exact in binary for a linear rule onto an integer (use_duration times 20: how BDS rounds); only what BDS accepts and sends is evidence.

unpinnedEnums._comment: Schema enums whose values the add-on does not all try: it varies every value of the other schema enums (so a table of one is complete), cutting none at MAX_VALUES. By '<component>:<path>', with the reason.
unpinnedEnums.item:minecraft:record:sound_event: an open enum: api.json openEnums makes the field a string, so no table of the 571 sound events is built

listNames._comment: Names put in a list of names, by '<component>:<path>': the lists BDS sends as a set ordered by the hash of each name (uv_lock) are written in several orders of them (VariantValues.orderings). Inputs, not facts: any names do; the bone of the other samples comes first.

combinations._comment: Whole component maps (role combination), by component id: the component next to another one that writes the same wire leaf, so the capture says which value BDS keeps (SharedLeaves). wearable's slot table writes item_properties.max_stack_size and allow_off_hand; each pair disagrees on the leaf, in both orders of the file. Inputs, not facts.

descriptorValues._comment: Block descriptors tried in every field that is one (name, states and tags members), each as the whole descriptor: real vanilla blocks (Bedrock's state names) with enum values (all of pillar_axis, to see their order on the wire; two of cardinal_direction and lever_direction), an unlisted and an integer one, booleans, strings for a boolean and an integer state, and an integer for contrast. BDS's registry decides which it takes and how it sends them (enum index, state type).

context._comment: Extra description entries a component's variants need (states its conditions refer to).

sweepValues._comment: Whole values the format sweep tries for the components BDS rejects at the current format, at every known format besides their base (inputs, not evidence: BDS decides).

skip.block:minecraft:tag: tag:<name> components; the docs page has no table (probed by hand in capture/addon: rejected by 1.26.60)

hashCollision._comment: Two custom blocks chosen to collide: the first pair of paletter:hash_<n> whose single states (no properties) have the same network hash (HashCollisions.firstPair; HashCollisionsTest checks they collide, ./gradlew :tools:slowTests that the search gives them). The add-on writes them as plain blocks in the creative inventory, so the capture shows which of them BDS gives the hash and which the next id (HashCollisionCaptureTest, docs/wire-notes.md).

scriptComponents._comment: Script custom components of the spec add-on: what its script registers (name: callbacks) and the variants that bind them (role script). Callback names are the optional members of BlockCustomComponent and ItemCustomComponent in the index.d.ts of @minecraft/server 2.0.0 (npm), the pinned module version. A variant's json is the custom_components value: an array is the old form (up to format 1.21.80), an object holds components that are keys of their own, and may hold permutations. Under the placers the json is the whole components map.

replacedBy._comment: Components that replace a deprecated or rejected one when neither the docs text, the docs notes, the BDS message nor a field name says so (see Replacements): by (component ids) and the evidence, both required.

block:minecraft:queued_ticking.evidence: BDS 1.26.63.1 rejects queued_ticking as deprecated (data/bds/1.26.63.1/spec/content-log.txt: member "minecraft:queued_ticking" is deprecated); the docs page of minecraft:tick lists the interval_range and looping fields of queued_ticking and sends the onTick event to custom components (queued_ticking triggers a named event instead).
